## Allocation-01 H/T/D/C/U freeze — before any candidate invocation

**H:** In one frozen deterministic portfolio, a complete type/dependency/order ledger plus one global alpha-spending procedure will refuse calibrated claims for deterministic checks, descriptive outcomes, correlated/invalid p-values, STOP/HOLD and hard-safety failure. For the fixed synthetic stream, naive per-claim alpha=.05 should have a larger false-discovery fraction than the eligible global procedure; this one seeded result is descriptive, not an error-rate estimate.

**T:** Branch `research/portfolio-multiplicity-5890-t0-20261001-r1`, additive path `research/analysis/portfolio_multiplicity_5890_t0_v1/`, base main `5865c5e74842b5bba6a6291e141afae75ca4a147`. Freeze candidate and separate raw-only auditor before launch. 32 ordered portfolios ×13 opportunities (416): per portfolio 4 alternatives +3 null valid statistical claims, one null p-value copied into a dependent/ineligible record, deterministic method PASS/FAIL, descriptive-only, hard-safety failure with tempting p, and STOP. Seed 58901001. Null p-values are discrete super-uniform 1..1,000,000/1,000,000; alternative p-values use seeded U^5. One global registered-order alpha-spending rule uses αᵢ=.05/[i(i+1)] over 224 eligible tests. Completion order is separately permuted. One candidate invocation, then one independent raw-only audit only if exit 0; no retries.

**D:** `PASS_METHOD_SCOPED` only if all 416 opportunities reconcile; the global rule promotes no null; fixed-seed unadjusted eligible FDP exceeds online FDP; every non-statistical/dependent class refuses calibrated inference; safety always blocks; and seven frozen corruptions (omission, duplicate, reordered start, shared-cohort relabel, posthoc family relabel, invented method p-value, forged safety) reject. Otherwise retain exact FAIL/HOLD/STOP.

**C:** Alpha spending is conservative and may lose power; a single sealed comparison may not need a portfolio procedure; simulated p-values and truth are not real agent evidence.

**U:** No real task/runtime/GUI/model data, no empirical FDR guarantee, no promotion or relaxed safety gate.

**Execution deviation:** Intended Docker was not usable (desktop CLI stalls; C: has 0 free bytes). Per local-shell fallback direction, conduct a strictly in-memory host-only PowerShell run on this Windows PC, no filesystem writes. Environment/process details and raw/audit hashes will be appended after the sole run. Preparation branch was created from the stated exact main; no output or candidate has run yet.

## Successor allocation-02 T0 result — PASS_METHOD_SCOPED (synthetic only)

The new source-frozen allocation is retained in [PR #5945](https://github.com/Unjuno/agent-interface/pull/5945), with its own ID/seed/path; allocation-01's `STOP_MAIN_ADVANCED_AND_STORAGE_ZERO` and r1 branch are unchanged.

One fixed stream reconciled 416/416 rows. Unadjusted p<.05 promoted 2/96 null and 49/96 alternative claims (FDP 2/51 = 0.0392). Registered-order `alpha_i=0.05/[i(i+1)]` promoted 0 null and 11 alternative claims (FDP 0/11). All 7 mutation controls rejected, including invented p-values on deterministic methods and forged removal of a hard-safety failure. The hard-safety rows carried p=1e-6 but were not statistically eligible and were never promoted. These single-seed synthetic counts are descriptive, not an empirical FDR guarantee.

CPython 3.12.10, standard library only; 5/5 construction tests and syntax check passed before freeze; source SHA receipts precede one candidate and one separate raw-only audit. No Docker/container, model, GUI, game, input, network, or shared resource use.
